result.title: Minimum Description Length Unsupervisedly Separates Law-Grade from Statistical-Grade Knowledge in a Self-Improving Science Agent - and Reveals 86% of Its Own Discoveries Are Statistical
result.summary: AI systems that discover scientific relations now generate candidate "laws" at scale, but the bottleneck has shifted from generation to vetting: which candidates deserve belief? We show that a deployed self-improving science agent - one that has admitted 252 relations through held-out prediction courts - already computes the quantity that answers this question: the Minimum Description Length compression ratio used for model selection doubles, when read under discrete accounting, as an unsupervised epistemic grader. The compression-ranked top band of the agent's ledger recovers exactly the canonical laws among its discoveries (vis-viva across seven planets, Balmer/Rydberg) plus cross-measurement identities - enrichment $p=3.6\times10^{-12}$ under a hypergeometric test - with zero counterexamples and physically coherent band structure. The same lens retroactively reveals that 86% of the ledger compresses nothing ($\mathrm{cr}\approx 1$): the agent had been recording statistical regularities, including a learned predictor with held-out $R^2=0.541$ admitted through the prediction gate, under a narrative of compression as the unified value of knowledge - a narrative that was never true for them. We formalize the resulting dual-axis bookkeeping - prediction value ($R^2$) and compression value (cr) as nearly decoupled axes of knowledge - demonstrate its robustness to quantization, and register forward falsifiable predictions. The episode is, to our knowledge, the first measured instance of a discovery agent auditing its own knowledge ledger by an internal measure and finding itself over-claiming.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察一个自改进科学发现 agent 的 252 条候选关系账本，发现其用于模型选择的 Minimum Description Length 压缩比可作为无监督的「知识分级器」：压缩比最高的条目恰好对应经典定律与跨测量恒等式，而 86% 的条目压缩比约等于 1，实为统计规律；作者据此提出预测价值与压缩价值的双轴记账，并给出可falsify的前瞻预测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用内部压缩度量区分「真正结构」与「什么也没压缩」的统计规律，可供核查是否能迁移为判断 latent 推理状态是否承载任务必要信息、以及为推理贡献分配提供无监督评估准则。
